instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "When I am about to decide something, show what I decided in similar decisions before, what came next and how each turned out", and give it decision_id (The decision about to be made).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:bring-back-similar-decisions and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Reads the person's own decision records.
4. It reads only the records handed in as `records` (decision; decision-revision; decision-option; decision-candidate; decision-report; decision-part; decision-refs). It changes nothing.
